- [RLOW.1.6] **A rule the compiler cannot lower is refused.** The compiler
  must not write an artefact without a rule its source declares. When it cannot
  lower a rule, it must refuse the compile with `DS_VALIDATE_RULE_NOT_LOWERED`:
  one diagnostic per such rule, at the rule's span, naming the rule and the
  construct the lowering could not handle. The code is the same for every
  construct; the reason travels in the message.

  An unfinished lowering is therefore a compile-time stop, never an artefact
  that silently does less than its source says.

---
